# Fate UI v0.9.3-beta1

This prerelease makes Fate UI self-sufficient: it owns its provider credentials, connects providers in-app, and no longer needs the Pi terminal program at all.

## SDK-only runtime with owned credentials

- Fate UI embeds the Pi SDK (upgraded to 0.84.2) and runs it inside its Electron main process. Installing Fate UI is enough; the `pi` terminal program is neither started, shelled out to, nor required.
- Provider credentials and model configuration now live in Fate UI's own store under `~/.pi/fateGUI/`. On the first run only, existing Pi `auth.json` and `models.json` are copied in. Later Pi Terminal changes never silently alter Fate UI credentials or models, and Fate UI never falls back to the shared files after that first import.
- Pi sessions, settings, MCP configuration, skills, prompt templates, and extensions stay shared and compatible through the SDK.
- The provider store is private: user-only directory (0700) and file (0600) permissions on macOS and Linux, re-checked on every start, and non-regular files such as symlinks are rejected instead of followed. Windows relies on the user profile's existing access control.

## Connect your AI in-app

- A new Connect your AI card and sign-in dialog replace the old `/login` guidance. Providers can be connected with OAuth device-code flows or an API key, entirely inside Fate UI, and disconnected again per provider.
- The welcome screen leads with the connection step. Authentication errors now point to the in-app flow instead of the terminal.

## Music player media pipeline

- Track playback streams through a private `fate-media:` scheme with per-session tokens instead of direct file or network access.
- Remote media is prefetched into a bounded cache (192 MB, 6 files, 64 MB per file) with paced delivery, a 90-minute stream cache, a 3-redirect limit, and proxy tunnel support.
- The player shows a visible status line for readiness, skips, and extractor errors; queued tracks resolve durations in the background.

## Composer

- Prompt polish gains an advanced mode: before improving a prompt, the agent explores the project read-only and improves the draft with the findings. Toggle it in Settings, Agent defaults.

## Fixed

- Radix UI packages are pinned to the CI-proven versions after their patch upgrade split dismissable-layer instances, which broke Escape dismissal for composer popovers.
- The e2e suite stubs the new music status sink and follows the redesigned welcome screen and visible music status line (test-only).

## Verification

- Local validation: TypeScript typecheck, 144 Vitest files / 1356 tests, e2e suite 4/4, and production build passed on Windows.
- GitHub Actions run [31895374145](https://github.com/Master0fFate/pi-fategui/actions/runs/31895374145) passed on Windows x64, macOS Apple Silicon, macOS Intel, and Linux x64. Each platform built, installed, and smoked its artifacts.

## Notes

- Upgrading from earlier betas: the first launch of this version imports your existing Pi credentials once and then manages them independently. Your Pi sessions, skills, and settings are untouched.
- Public beta installers are unsigned. Verify each download against the `SHA256SUMS` file shipped with the release.
